texts.title: Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd
texts.author: Abū Ḥāmid Turka al-Iṣfahānī
texts.note: 61 unchanged original matn units, plus 110 translated commentary units: 40 introductory, 64 continuous main explanations including four additional connecting passages, and six concluding units. All authorial commentary in the consulted N introduction and A pp.48–274 is translated. Lumbard is checked where his selection overlaps. The reported QT059 loss remains noted and unreconstructed. Complete source-based working translation; independent manuscript collation and specialist review remain open.
texts.separate_original_matn_publication: Majid Hadizadeh edition, Nusus wa-Rasail IV:37-72 (not yet inspected)

texts.title: al-Mustaṣfā min ʿIlm al-Uṣūl
texts.author: Abū Ḥāmid al-Ghazālī
texts.note: Full Arabic witness; selected technical English translation, glossary and intertextual apparatus; English not complete

texts.title: al-Ḍarūrī fī Uṣūl al-Fiqh
texts.author: Ibn Rushd
texts.note: Bilingual scholarly reading edition with 258 authorial sections plus colophon, 416 aligned passages, explanatory notes, and selected classical dictionary excerpts. AI-assisted, not manuscript-collated.

texts.title: al-Baḥr al-Madīd
texts.author: Ibn ʿAjība
texts.note: Complete recovered Volume I: preface through Q 4:176, 389 Arabic–English passages, 209 current annotations, 241 Cairo notes, 48 report dossiers, 352 source occurrences, indices, dictionary and four unchanged PDF editions. Critical working edition; independent manuscript collation and specialist review remain outstanding.

texts.title: Sharḥ al-Mawāqif
texts.author: al-Jurjānī
texts.note: Separate ongoing translation; not yet migrated into this repository. A limited scholarly reader preview is now available; source corpus still awaits import.

texts.title: Bidāyat al-Mujtahid
texts.author: Ibn Rushd
texts.note: Two edition research previews. Each now includes the recovered separate 25-case alternative-uṣūl casebook (12 full dossiers, 13 supplemental reviews, 115 source records); Edition II includes separate formation hypotheses. The canonical Revision16 primary text and 310/279 research registers remain unavailable and unimported.

texts.title: Tahdhīb al-Kalām
texts.author: Saʿd al-Dīn al-Taftāzānī
texts.note: All 113 original Cairo 1912 kalam pages have page-linked English draft; selected passages are expanded or clause-verified, but 38 of the older 83 thematic units retain gap=true and other portions are not yet fully literal. Not a definitive edition.
texts.enhanced_reader_status: Stage 75 complete 1,044-clause bilingual working edition; 108/113 Cairo print pages checked; five pending; no independent manuscript certification
texts.pdf_edition_status: Published working editions from canonical corpus; not independent manuscript certified

texts.title: Taqrīb al-Marām fī Sharḥ Tahdhīb al-Kalām
texts.arabic: تقريب المرام في شرح تهذيب الكلام
texts.author: ʿAbd al-Qādir al-Sanandajī
texts.note: 50-page source-following English draft I:13–62 recovered; Arabic–English selected commentary through I:80, with main text and ḥāshiya distinguished. Next requested 100-page translation I:81–180 is not started as matn remains unfinished.

texts.title: Tahdhīb al-Manṭiq
texts.author: Saʿd al-Dīn al-Taftāzānī
texts.note: 19 bilingual divisions of the Cairo 1912 logic matn restored in source order, including repaired L.11 modalities and removal of an unwitnessed commentary addition in L.16. Explanatory notes and the النظريات/فطريات variant recorded; independent manuscript collation not complete.
texts.enhanced_reader_status: Stage78: 19/19 complete bilingual logic divisions mapped to Cairo 1912 printed pp3–14; seven compared printed readings recorded; L13 and L16 Cairo text corrected, Stage77 L16 misattribution explicitly retracted. All modal-inference and manuscript proofing remains open.
texts.pdf_edition_status: Published working editions from canonical corpus; not independent manuscript certified

texts.title: Bidāyat al-Ḥikma
texts.author: Sayyid Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
texts.note: Original reading guide and twelve-stage correspondence with Nihāya. Qarāʾī’s published ICAS English translation is linked, not reproduced. Full new translation awaits a supplied or clearly reusable Arabic source.

texts.title: Nihāyat al-Ḥikma
texts.author: Sayyid Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
texts.note: Fresh AI-assisted English working translation in 136/136 reading sections, covering 130 numbered chapters plus introductions when complete. Arabic authorial corpus and page locators from the Qum 1417 transcription; Qum 1404 NYU/Princeton scan identified as public domain. Selected print checks only; exhaustive collation and independent specialist review remain open. Later editorial additions excluded.
